title: Livelier meetings, every emoji looking its best

items.text: Every meeting reaction now animates, and each of the 28 plays across the screen in its own way.
Thirty-one backgrounds, including twelve that move and your own video, plus fifteen face effects.
React in a meeting with any emoji at all, and send stickers or GIFs from new one-tap categories.
Emoji look crisp and modern on every computer, and a message of only emoji shows big.
The iPhone and Android apps open on a new loading screen, the same as the desktop app.
